intermediate_failures: The first Linux experiment assumed source-image filters used native BGRA; direct RGBA image filtering preserves unpremultiplied sRGB storage on both platforms. Alpha type and color space are now retained in FilterResult.

A fractional shadow offset changed by one float ulp when evaluated relative to a padded source device. Shadow merge/sampling now uses the original layer coordinates; native regression input is committed.
An array-assignment compile error in the new corpus generator was corrected with an explicit clone.
limits: Counts include no-ops and conservative declines.
The direct image route still requires integral translation, in-bounds integral source and destination rectangles of equal size, and full paint alpha.
General source-image sampling, remaining spatial chains, rotated layers, SVG graphs, large-sigma rescaling, tiled surfaces and native browser bridges remain open.
The browser still links Skia; no Skia-free browser compile/link/run is claimed.
